title: Latent daily review · Nov 2
tldr: No new fixes from me today. All 5 new in-app notes already have tickets or are a policy call: Jack's camera going blurry is TRY-647 (Malcolm's bot has a fix branch waiting for approval), and the asks (any part of a song, timelapse length, groups for one activity) are known tickets. Your 3 dig PRs are still waiting: #617 and #633 (empty videos) and #653 (Spotify keeps playing). One PR merged overnight: Malcolm's #685 (close friends first in the Home feed, behind an on/off switch).

Big day for new people: 1,007 installs (was 625) and 773 finished onboarding (was 475). Empty-video upload failures rose with it: 1,140 from about 78 people (was 904 from about 55), 1,079 of them on the App Store build 1.0.10. Merging #617 and #633 gets the fix into the next build.

Age holds: none. A second under-13 report came in: TRY-648 (@jaydenpashut reported @ank twice last night, no note; account says teen, nothing mentions an age). TRY-642 (@jesser0ff) is still open too. No holds placed; that's your or Malcolm's call.

Colby asked the app to stop filtering his swearing (a product call, TRY-422 is related). Malcolm's bot filed TRY-650: brand new accounts can freeze for about 5 seconds on the dimmed example week chart (third time, seen in Sentry). Sign-ups failed 15 times for 6 people (was 0), no reason recorded, worth watching.

Discord: very quiet, no bugs and no new threads. One more vote for a live status note while recording (❤️ 201k: "This would be cool"). Someone asked where drafts are and another member answered. Custom timelapse length vote still 10 / 3. Still no reply from you or Malcolm on the older threads (Instagram share bug, LinkedIn, storage, group sessions, music button, data access, rank on profile, Monday week start, flip timelapse, sub-categories), or on Luzimi's Android question and snoozzntmy's growth-applicant question in #general-chat. No reply drafts (no new app-user emails, only pitches). No new survey answers. 0 new beta opt-ins (176). 4.91 stars (209). Invalid invite code tries 203 from 57 people. Sentry still needs re-auth.

bugs.title: Back camera goes blurry and stays that way
bugs.status: Malcolm's bot TRY-647 (Need Approval, branch ready)
bugs.summary: Jack (@jackhammer) on 1.0.10: “Camera can get off focus and then you can’t see anything.”
bugs.detail: The camera focuses when you hit Record and then holds on purpose. If the phone gets bumped or moved, it stays soft until you tap. The bot's branch refocuses once after the phone is moved and then sits still.

bugs.title: App freezes for about 5 seconds for brand new accounts
bugs.summary: Sentry caught the phone stuck for 5 to 6 seconds on the dimmed example week chart a new account sees on its profile. Third time (Oct 20, Nov 1, today).
bugs.detail: That chart keeps animating every few seconds even when you're on another tab. The bot's idea: only animate it while the profile is on screen. It's a hunch, not proven.

bugs.title: Someone is upset the app filters their swearing
bugs.summary: Colby (@colbymf): “Don’t censor me when I curse… I have to use numbers which makes me look like an idiot.”
bugs.detail: This is the filter doing what it's meant to do, so I didn't open a fix. Whether to relax it is a product decision.
